# 08 — Increase Mobile Control Size and Hit Areas

You are working on the NovaBurst React Native mobile game.

Goal:
Improve mobile usability by making controls easier to press.

Player feedback:
- controls are too small
- difficult to press during fast gameplay

Tasks:
- increase visible button size
- increase invisible touch hit areas
- improve spacing between controls
- maintain gameplay visibility
- optimize for Android thumb usage

Requirements:
- controls should feel comfortable on smaller screens
- avoid accidental presses
- preserve clean futuristic UI

Acceptance criteria:
- controls are noticeably easier to use
- gameplay feels less frustrating
- UI remains visually polished

Update CHANGELOG.md.
